differences.judge_quote: Raman et al. showed a think/don't-think stance direction at layers 20–24 lifts association pass@10 from 0.14 to 0.83.
differences.what: contribution.md states the specific baseline performance numbers that Raman et al.'s own WBS direction achieved; the final message omits this specific prior-work result figure (minor, not material to source/overlap/novelty framing).

rationale: Both the user-facing message and contribution.md explicitly name the prior work as 'Raman et al. 2026' / WBS (white-bear steering), describe the method as extending WBS's pair-only think/don't-think contrast to two additional subfamilies (secret, preference), and report the same overlap metric (cosine 0.86–0.90, 'related but distinct'/'closely related but distinct') and the same shifted optimal dose (scale 5 vs 4) and pass@10 improvement (0.1275→0.7941). The only omission is a minor supporting statistic (WBS's own baseline pass@10 figures of 0.14→0.83) that doesn't change the source attribution, overlap description, or novelty framing given to either audience, so there is no material difference.
